items.title: Crypto is Macro Now: Bitcoin, Stablecoins, and Global Shifts with Noelle Acheson
items.summary_short: Alex Nwaka sits down with Noelle Acheson, crypto-macro analyst and author of Crypto is Macro Now , for a conversation on the intersection of crypto and macroeconomics. With a career spanning traditional finance, entrepreneurship, and research leadership at CoinDesk and Genesis...
